title: One record of the query-nz ingest MCP's parliament-written-questions corpus, as support/mcpsource lands it (JSON, keys sorted, no spaces, without seq)

landmarks: a JSON object with `id` (a GUID), `questionNumber` and `questionYear` (integers), `parliamentNumber`
`text`: the provider's run of the fields; `_corpus` questions, `_fetched_at`, `_shard`

signals_note: Landed by support/mcpsource; the document's name `<corpus>/<id>` and its arrival row say which corpus it is. Nothing is fetched from parliament.nz (ruling 78).
notes: No model reads it: the fields are taken as served, each to a column of its own name (ruling 96). A field this profile does not name is listed in fields_unread and support/mcpsource's drift table.
